children: German industrial orders exceeded expectations in July, rising by 2.5% on the previous month on a seasonally and calendar adjusted basis, the federal statistics office said on Friday.
A Reuters poll of analysts had pointed to an increase of 0.3%.
The statistics office publishes more economic data on its website.
